shared: Your own units dying, in fights or on purpose while recruiting, is what grows your board.
differ: What a death turns into: a pile shared out evenly, a bigger replacement, or saved-up change.

takes.label: A quarter each
takes.line: Each death adds its printed stats to one pile that empties nightly; every Fruit unit takes a quarter, so none miss out.
takes.look_if: deaths poured into one pile that grows every carrier at once.

takes.label: Sell it, it sprouts
takes.line: Selling counts as dying, and here Fruit means a lost unit regrows in its slot, bigger with each funeral so far.
takes.look_if: selling as a weapon, and fights where fallen slots refill bigger.

takes.label: Making exact change
takes.line: Each death banks one point that carries over; Fruit units pay set prices in board order, so seating decides who gets fed.
takes.look_if: a seating-and-spending puzzle each turn, with small, sure gains.
